exports.name: DuiDirectivesModule
exports.summary: Angular module `DuiDirectivesModule` declaring and exporting dui directives module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `DuiDirectivesModule`，声明并导出DUI指令模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。

exports.name: DuiIfOnDomDirective
exports.summary:
Structural-like directive that creates its embedded view only once the host element is
actually attached to `document.body` (checked on every content-check cycle), and clears
it again once detached.
exports.summaryZh:
类结构型指令：仅当宿主元素真正挂载到 `document.body` 后（在每次内容检查周期中判断）
才创建其内嵌视图，一旦从文档中移除则清空视图。

properties.name: isCreated
properties.description: Whether the embedded view has currently been created (i.e. the host element is attached to the DOM).
properties.descriptionZh: 内嵌视图当前是否已创建（即宿主元素是否已挂载到 DOM）。
